title: The Granite Dome of Mount Kyllang (Lum Kyllang)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
U Lum Kyllang u ieng rasong ha suin,
U mawsiang bakhraw bym ju khih da ka lyer;
U sakhi ia ki thma bad ki por ba la leit,
Kum u syiem ba ap pahara ia ka Ri.

Wat la u slap u ther bad ka 'leilieh ka kyrthep,
U Kyllang u ieng skhem klem da kynran dien;
Kumta u Khasi u dei ban ieng ha ka hok,
Klem da sheptieng ia ki jingeh ka pyrthei.
lyrics_english:
Mount Kyllang towers majestic against the blue sky,
A colossal granite dome unmoved by tempest winds;
Witness to ancient wars and passing ages,
Like a silent monarch standing sentinel over the land.

Though monsoon deluges crash and thunderbolts flash,
Kyllang stands resolute without retreat;
So too must the Khasi stand firm in righteousness,
Dauntless before the tribulations of the world.
